title: Find the Most Frequent Number
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the number that appears most often. If multiple numbers have the same highest frequency, return the first one that reaches that frequency.
think: What is the task asking? Find which number has the highest count.
What is the key operation? Count numbers, then track the best frequency.
What wording signals stand out? Most frequent, appears most often.
What is the brute force idea? Count each number by rescanning the whole array.
What is the better/optimal idea? Build frequency map in one pass and track best as counts grow.
What are the edge cases? Ties, negative numbers, one element.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(k) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I maintain counts and update the current winner when a count becomes larger.
algorithm: If current count > bestCount, update winner
interview: I would use a frequency map and track the current winner as counts are updated.
ru: Сначала считаем частоты, а заодно следим, у какого числа счётчик сейчас самый большой.
visualExplanation:
nums = [4,1,4,2,4,2]

nice: Do not explain winner-tracking while counting

gaps: Nice to have: mention tie behavior clearly
constraints: Assume nums has at least one element.
whyThisPattern: This is a Dictionary problem because the core operation is counting occurrences per number.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not HashSet, because uniqueness is not enough.
Not Sorting, because sorting is unnecessary if we only need frequency winner.
